decks.notes: The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Return. It also utilizes control elements such as Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis provides additional value and flexibility in dealing with threats. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with big threats while controlling the board to secure victory.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming opponents with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to play efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. The deck also includes powerful support cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Arena of Glory to help maintain board control and push through damage. Overall, the goal is to apply constant pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly through fast creature attacks and burn damage.

The main strategy of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Ugin's Labyrinth, Talisman of Impulse, and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Kozilek's Command. The deck also focuses on control elements with cards like Malevolent Rumble and Kozilek's Return to deal with threats on the board. The inclusion of cards like Sowing Mycospawn and Writhing Chrysalis provide additional value and utility. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with powerful Eldrazi creatures while controlling the game.

This Grixis Control deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's game plan through a combination of countermagic, removal spells, and card advantage. It utilizes powerful threats like Snapcaster Mage and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to outvalue opponents in the late game. The deck also includes versatile cards like Kolaghan's Command and Force of Negation to handle a variety of situations. By controlling the board and manipulating the opponent's resources, this deck aims to grind out victories in a long game.

This deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing Leyline effects, the deck aims to control the board while dealing consistent damage through efficient creatures like Nishoba Brawler, Ragavan, and Territorial Kavu. The deck also packs a variety of removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames to clear the way for its creatures. With a mix of creature aggression and spell control, this deck aims to close out games quickly before the opponent can establish a solid defense.

The deck focuses on quickly assembling the Allosaurus Rider combo by using cards like Neoform and Eldritch Evolution to tutor for creatures. It also utilizes cards like Pact of Negation to protect its combo pieces and generate mana efficiently with cards like Disciple of Freyalise. The overall goal is to ramp up quickly into playing a Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant or Griselbrand for a game-winning swing. The deck also includes some control elements like Pact of Negation and Boseiju, Who Endures to protect its plays and disrupt opponent strategies.

The deck focuses on assembling a combo using cards like Basking Broodscale, Glaring Fleshraker, and Blade of the Bloodchief to generate a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruption elements like Soul-Guide Lantern and Boseiju, Who Endures to control the game. The deck utilizes ramp cards like Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga to accelerate its game plan, while also including finishers like Emrakul, the Promised End to close out games.Overall, the key concept of the deck is to create a synergistic combo engine that can quickly take over the game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Eldrazi creatures and artifacts to create a powerful combo, including cards like Glaring Fleshraker, Basking Broodscale, and Eldrazi Linebreaker. It also makes use of Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble for removal and disruption. The deck includes cards that generate mana like Urza's Saga and Eldrazi Temple, and supports the combo with cards like Blade of the Bloodchief and Walking Ballista. The inclusion of cards like Emrakul, the Promised End and Boseiju, Who Endures adds additional power and resilience to the deck's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly comboing off with cards like Goryo's Vengeance to reanimate powerful creatures like Griselbrand and Solitude while disrupting opponents with cards like Force of Negation and Spell Snare. Utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Psychic Frog to control the board and dig for combo pieces, the deck aims to quickly assemble a game-winning board state. The inclusion of Leyline Binding helps protect key combo pieces from removal spells, allowing the deck to perform its instant reanimation combo with efficiency and consistency.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be repeatedly blinked (exiled and returned to the battlefield) for value. The key strategy is to continuously blink key creatures like Emperor of Bones and Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd to generate advantage and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the game and protect its aggressive game plan. The synergy between blinking creatures and powerful enter the battlefield effects is the main theme of this deck.

The main concept of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly and efficiently, utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor, Primeval Titan, and Scapeshift to create explosive combos and win conditions. The deck focuses on generating large amounts of mana through lands and creatures, allowing for powerful plays early in the game. With the ability to tutor for key pieces and generate multiple land drops per turn, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its speed and versatility, ultimately leading to a swift victory in the Modern format.

The key concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to play aggressively with a combination of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and powerful spells like Galvanic Discharge and Thraben Charm. The deck also includes ways to generate extra value and damage with cards like Voice of Victory, Goblin Bombardment, and Seasoned Pyromancer. The mana base is focused on fetching for the right colors of mana with cards like Marsh Flats and Arid Mesa, while also including disruptive elements like Static Prison. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a combination of speed and synergy.

The deck focuses on using low-cost aggressive creatures and efficient spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By combining cheap burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Lava Dart with creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Dragon's Rage Channeler, the deck aims to apply pressure early in the game and finish off the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of cantrips like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration helps to ensure a consistent stream of threats and answers. Overall, the deck aims to win by overwhelming the opponent with fast, efficient aggression.

The key concept of this deck revolves around utilizing combo pieces like Glaring Fleshraker, Malevolent Rumble, and Blade of the Bloodchief to quickly build up a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also utilizes cards like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga to search for key pieces and create a strong synergy between its cards. By efficiently deploying creatures like Basking Broodscale and Walking Ballista, the deck aims to generate value and control the board while setting up for a game-winning play with Emrakul, the Promised End.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays while also utilizing blink effects to gain value and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It includes a mix of powerful creatures like Solitude and Ketramose, paired with cards that can disrupt the opponent's strategy like Thoughtseize and Relic of Progenitus. By effectively blinking key creatures and utilizing removal spells, the deck aims to apply pressure and control the game, ultimately overwhelming the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays using a mix of different colors to overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with Leyline cards to control the board. Stubborn Denial provides protection while Lightning Bolt and Tribal Flames offer direct damage to the opponent. The deck also includes mana fixing and ramp cards to ensure smooth gameplay, making it a versatile and potent aggro strategy.
